scope: Released-SDK baseline for the WW28 fire-size visualiser case.
supported: add_parameter for the location/latitude/longitude/acres/zoom inputs, including list aliases
add_calculated_field with MAKEPOINT, SQRT/PI and BUFFER spatial expressions
configure_chart(mark_type='Map', map_layer_mode='native', map_layers=[...]) for the fire + zoom buffer layers
configure_worksheet_style(panes_style=...) to make the zoom ring transparent
add_dashboard_action(action_type='parameter', aggregation='min'/'sum') for Set Lat / Set Long

findings.summary: A native buffer layer without a Detail field does not resolve its geometry, so the map stays at world scale instead of zooming to the buffer.
findings.workaround: Give each buffer layer its own Detail field (the geometry expression itself), as the author's workbook does.
